text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts across batching/scheduler path in us-west-2. error-rate 5xx ~ 12% over 5m, tail latency > 10s for some requests. Auto-escalation to P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batching-hol-5xx

oncall-robin: I'm on it. paging SREs and scheduler owners. setting incident channel, severity P1, customer-impact: elevated timeouts, some sessions dropped.

sre-amy: saw the alert, attaching current metric snapshot. 5xx is concentrated on scheduler shards 7-9; queue depth up 4x. KV-cache occupancy increased ~30%. suspect head-of-line blocking from long-running cold batches.

eng-scheduler: confirmed. there's a backlog due to a recent traffic spike from an embed-heavy client and a couple of large, long-context live batches. Batching window expanded which amplified hol.

infra-luis: rolling new instances in us-west-2 now to add capacity, but scaling will take ~3-4m to warm. can we open fallback routing to other regions / model variants?

oncall-robin: yes. prioritize safety: 1) enable regional overflow to us-west-1 for non-SLA customers 2) throttle non-interactive embed job traffic 3) evict stuck batches with head_timeout policy.

ops-eli: pushing a temporary rate-limit rule to drop/queue long-context jobs above 30s. command: ```./infractl rate-limit set --scope=batching --threshold=30s --action=deprioritize```

eng-scheduler: adding: we can enable per-client priority preemption. rolling config: ```scheduler.preempt.enabled=true``` and immediate effect. preemption will evict largest pending batches first to break head-of-line. Doing canary on shards 7-9.

support-jenna: FYI support: multiple customers reporting request timeouts and retries; one enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported failures for their background embedding ingestion. opening incident ticket with priority and notifying account team.

product-micah: customer-impact note: product API (generation/chat) saw increased error rate ~8% for interactive keys; embeddings ingestion saw higher failure ~15% for bulk jobs. Need to include guidance for SDK retries and recommend smaller batch sizes.

eng-scheduler: can reproduce locally a sequence that causes a single long batch to stall the scheduler thread and block subsequent smaller batches -> head-of-line. Root cause likely an unexpected long token count from a client causing batch growth + KV cache pressure.

infra-luis: warm instances are healthy; but we have kernel-level NPU scheduling issues on 1 node causing slow token loops. pulling that node from rotation. nodes 10 and 11 tainted out.

oncall-robin: action list (in-flight):
- [x] page SRE + eng-scheduler
- [x] set incident channel + P1
- [x] start warmup of extra capacity (us-west-2)
- [x] taint slow node(s) out of rotation
- [ ] enable overflow routing to us-west-1 for non-enterprise customers (in progress)
- [ ] roll preemption config to affected shards (in progress)
- [ ] throttle embed bulk traffic (in progress)
- [ ] notify account teams and post status update to customers (support + product)

sre-amy: implementing eviction command to remove stuck batches on shard 8: ```/evict-batches --shard=8 --reason="hol-evict" --max-evict=20``` will free up scheduling slots. running now.

eng-scheduler: eviction completed on shard 8, queue depth reduced ~45% there. telemetry shows immediate drop in 5xx on that shard. continuing roll to shards 7 and 9.

support-jenna: posted interim status to status.redwood.com: "Partial disruption for some requests in us-west-2; mitigation in progress."
